**Registration / Matriculation Fee:** ~VND 20,000,000 – 70,000,000+ (one-time upon acceptance)

**Payment Terms:** Nearly all schools offer a **5%–10% discount** if tuition is paid annually upfront rather than term-by-term, along with sibling discounts (typically 5%–15% for the 2nd and 3rd child)
